# GET /api/v1/users/{username}/orgs/{org}/permissions

Get user permissions in organization

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-028`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| username | path | string | True |
| org | path | string | True |

## Response

**200** — OrganizationPermissions

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `is_owner` | bool | user is org owner |
| `is_admin` | bool | user is org admin |
| `can_write` | bool | user can write |
| `can_read` | bool | user can read |
| `can_create_repository` | bool | user can create repos in org |

- **403** — Doer cannot see the org (visibility check)
- **404** — Org user not found or org not visible
- **500** — Database error in GetOrgUserMaxAuthorizeLevel or CanCreateOrgRepo

| 1 | [services](../modules/services.md) | context.UserAssignmentAPI | utility | Resolve username to user |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.GetUserByPathParam(ctx, "org") | controller | Resolve org name to user record |

### Data Transformations

**perm.AccessMode + bool** → **structs.OrganizationPermissions** (`GetUserOrgsPermissions`)

| Source Field | Target Field | Transformation |
|-------------|--------------|----------------|
| `authorizeLevel > AccessModeNone` | `CanRead` | computed |
| `authorizeLevel > AccessModeRead` | `CanWrite` | computed |
| `authorizeLevel > AccessModeWrite` | `IsAdmin` | computed |
| `authorizeLevel > AccessModeAdmin` | `IsOwner` | computed |
| `CanCreateOrgRepo result` | `CanCreateRepository` | direct_copy |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Org permissions endpoint requires org to be visible to doer | authorization | !organization.HasOrgOrUserVisible(ctx, o, ctx.Doer) |
| Permission levels are cumulative: owner > admin > write > read > none | business_logic | authorizeLevel compared against AccessMode constants |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Username or org does not exist | 404 | not found | False |
| HasOrgOrUserVisible returns false | 404 | not found | False |
| GetOrgUserMaxAuthorizeLevel or CanCreateOrgRepo fails | 500 | internal error | True |

### Error Paths

- **Username not found** → UserAssignmentAPI → 404
- **Org user not found** → GetUserByPathParam → 404
- **Org not visible to doer** → GetUserOrgsPermissions → 404
- **GetOrgUserMaxAuthorizeLevel fails** → GetUserOrgsPermissions → 500
- **CanCreateOrgRepo fails** → GetUserOrgsPermissions → 500
